Module 6 · Session 6.3 · 32 min

AWS release, runtime and rollback

A source-linked technical walkthrough with an executable-system perspective.

After this session, you can:
  • Describe the release boundary
  • Trace immutable deployment
  • Explain health rollback

Technical flow

1. Selective package

The demo package is built from an explicit allowlist and committed HEAD. Android apps, dependencies, local outputs and repository-wide archives are excluded.

2. Immutable release

Artifacts use immutable S3 keys with SHA-256 verification. First boot bootstraps once; ordinary updates use SSM, an atomic release switch and health checks. Schema mismatch fails closed.

3. Operations

CloudFormation owns infrastructure. Smoke tests, DNS plan, credentials, recovery and teardown follow the runbook. Showcase evidence does not equal production admission.
